scenes.title: Key ideas
items: Measure funding over time, not today
scenes.vo: Perpetual futures pay funding between longs and shorts to keep the perp near spot. In bullish markets longs usually pay shorts. Long spot + short perp at the same size equals no net price exposure, while collecting funding. Professional rules: First, Measure funding over time, not today. Use a 7- and 30-day average. Next, Exit rule: close when the 7-day average turns negative (you'd start paying). Then, Margin buffer: the short leg's leverage decides how big a rally it survives. And finally, Venue limits: split across venues; cap each one.
